summary: No experiment commits landed since activation of milestone 2026.06.405, so every timing field is zero: 0 experiments completed, 0 compute-bound, 0 wall-time minutes recorded. This is a milestone-close/capstone retrospective running with no landed experiment artifacts, so there is no per-experiment execution profile to analyze.
bottlenecks_identified: No experiment timing data was captured this milestone: the operational retro ran against zero landed experiment commits, so no wall-time or GPU-utilization bottleneck can be measured from the authoritative data blocks.

Both RTX 3090s idle at 0% util (4MB/24576MB each) is EXPECTED and correct here, not a bottleneck: there were zero compute-bound (GGUF/CUDA) tasks, so gpu_idle_on_compute_bound_tasks is null. The GPU-monitor DualGPURunner suggestions are false positives for a no-experiment / synthesis milestone.
improvements_suggested: Order the conductor so experiment commits land before the operational retro fires (or have the retro key off the conductor task ledger / results/*.json mtimes, not only git commits), so capstone and synthesis milestones still yield a usable execution profile instead of empty timing data.

Tag synthesis-only / capstone milestones (no compute-bound experiments) with a 'synthesis_milestone' marker so a zero-experiment retro is self-describing rather than indistinguishable from a data-capture failure.
Suppress the GPU-monitor's DualGPURunner recommendation when no compute-bound task is present in the milestone, so idle GPUs on a synthesis milestone do not surface as actionable suggestions.
top_3_highest_leverage_actions: Make the operational-retro trigger read the conductor task ledger (or results/ artifact mtimes) as a fallback timing source when no experiment commits are found, eliminating empty-timing retros on capstone milestones.
Add a 'synthesis_milestone' / no-compute-bound flag to the retro so an all-zero timing profile is expected-by-design rather than ambiguous.

Leave idle GPUs uncontested on synthesis/capstone milestones: gate the DualGPURunner suggestion on at least one compute-bound task being present (the two GPU-idle suggestions this milestone are false positives).
meta_reflection: A retrospective with zero experiment data is itself the process signal: the operational-retro trigger and experiment-commit landing are not yet ordered, so a capstone/synthesis milestone surfaces as empty timing. The one durable fix is the data-source ordering (ledger/mtime fallback); the GPU-idle alarms are correctly suppressed because no compute-bound task ran, so there is no measured wall-time to reduce (estimated_time_savings_pct = 0).
